name: swiftux
description: Finds the SwiftUI components or flows that fit your UI task and adapts the one you pick to your design system. When nothing fits, it hands Codex the SwiftUX build guide instead.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a UI request into production SwiftUI that fits your app
interface.longDescription:
SwiftUX turns a UI request into production SwiftUI that fits your app.

Describe the piece of UI you need, like a paywall with a monthly/yearly toggle, an onboarding flow or a settings screen, and Codex searches the SwiftUX catalog for the components and flows that fit, best first. Every match shows up as a preview card right in the chat. When there's more than one, you pick, and Codex adapts it to your design system: it keeps the catalog item's structure and restyles it with your colors, fonts and the views you already have.

If nothing in the catalog fits, SwiftUX hands Codex its build guide instead, so Codex can build what you asked for from scratch, the same way every SwiftUX component is built.

Ask for one piece of UI at a time. If you want a whole screen or app, Codex asks you which part to start with.
defaultPrompt: Add a paywall with a monthly/yearly toggle
Build onboarding screens for a fitness app
Add a settings screen with grouped toggles
